stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (admit rate 77.6%). No Common Data Set could be read: EKU's Institutional Research data page is a login/JavaScript app and no CDS PDF was found in two attempts, so no international split, GPA or residency data. Test scores from College Navigator cover enrolled first-time students (2,561 ACT, 97%; only 9 SAT, 1%, so SAT percentiles are omitted). International applicant counts are not published.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25 (tuition and fees, first-year full-time): in-state $10,320, out-of-state $21,230; on-campus food and housing $12,268; other expenses $3,650.
